CrowderSphere is a desktop editor for writing WordPress posts. Write with formatting and pictures, keep every post as a folder on your computer, export to Word, and send posts to your blog as drafts, published or scheduled. See the [README](https://github.com/mrdarthdan/crowdersphere#readme) for everything it does.

**Already have CrowderSphere 2.1 or later?** It offers this update by itself.

**Download the installer for your computer below:**
- **Windows 10/11:** `CrowderSphere_*_x64-setup.exe`
- **Mac (Intel and Apple silicon):** `CrowderSphere_*_universal.dmg`. First time: right-click the app and choose Open.
- **Linux:** `.AppImage`, `.deb` or `.rpm`

Your posts and WordPress connection are kept when you update. To uninstall on Windows, use Settings → Apps → Installed apps.

[Code signing policy](https://github.com/mrdarthdan/crowdersphere#code-signing-policy) · [Privacy](https://github.com/mrdarthdan/crowdersphere#privacy)
